summary: iter223 shipping enhancement (container/airport modes, polymorphic packing units with stacking, passengers & suitcases with bag-tag tracking, AI tracking via Gemini) fully tested. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass, all frontend testids render, mode toggle works both ways, AI tracking dialog returns a valid Gemini summary + tracking URL list. Regression on iter216-218 clean (45/45).
critical_code_review_comments: shipments.py is 2520 lines — consider splitting into shipments/{core,packing,airport,tracking,ai}.py in a future iter; hot path lookups (list comprehensions over items/suitcases/packing_units on every mutation) are fine at current scale but will get expensive past a few thousand items per shipment.

update_packing_unit / update_suitcase / update_passenger apply `[:300 if k=='notes' else 80/120]` slicing to non-string fields when v is falsy — currently v is coerced to '' so it's safe, but sending v=0 for a numeric field routed via the else branch could produce '' silently. Not triggered by current whitelist because numeric fields are pre-caught.

AI tracking: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY check happens before shipment existence check, so a request for a nonexistent shipment returns 503 (not 404) when the key is missing — acceptable but slightly misleading.
seed_data_creation: Test shipments created + cleaned up per test class; all data prefixed TEST_iter223 / TEST_ui223.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter223 endpoints all live at /api/shipments/{sid}/{packing-units,passengers,suitcases,ai-tracking} and /api/shipments/presets/packing-units. Frontend panel is /shipments → click ship-row → ShipmentPackingPanel above Manifest Groups. Mode default is 'container'. Cascade delete rules confirmed: parent pack-unit del → child.parent_id=None (child survives); passenger del → cascades to items (passenger_id+suitcase_id cleared) AND pulls suitcases; suitcase del → items.suitcase_id=None only.
